reference_taxonomy.scope: Provisional taxonomy and evidence reference; C coverage is not Rust port completion.

features.title: Startup logos and randomized opening
features.requirement: Show logos and select opening media according to original seed and configuration flags.

features.title: Title menu, day display and mode selection
features.requirement: Offer original normal-dream, flashback, save/load and chart routes with correct enabled states and day label.

features.title: 365-day progression and year ending
features.requirement: Advance normal dreams through 365 days, wrap the year and play the ending at the original boundary.

features.title: New-game state and reset
features.requirement: Reset original day, mood, unlock, recall and option data with the same marker and reserved fields.

features.title: Dream-session and map lifecycle
features.requirement: Start days, create maps, attach graphics/audio/actor state, handle transitions and release resources with original results.

features.title: Walking, running, strafing and looking
features.requirement: Preserve controller held/edge/release mapping, movement, turn/look states and temporary speed/direction changes.

features.title: Input suspension and scripted camera/movement takeover
features.requirement: Suspend or replace controls for original link/encounter sequences and restore them at the original point.

features.title: Transforms, collision and floor-surface response
features.requirement: Apply original position/orientation math, collision notifications and floor-specific movement/effect state.

features.title: Stage grids, chunk traversal and placed objects
features.requirement: Traverse 14 stage grids, choose chunk models and instantiate day/color-conditioned objects.

features.title: Touch-wall dynamic and fixed links
features.requirement: Use original permanent links or random destinations when wall contact and eligibility permit.

features.title: Facing-sensitive tunnel links
features.requirement: Traverse tunnels only with original facing/forward tests and source/target transforms.

features.title: Instant teleporters and time bonus
features.requirement: Enable, locate and execute teleporters with original bonus and target adjustment.

features.title: Staircase links
features.requirement: Traverse staircase nodes with original direction checks, transforms and spawn index.

features.title: Link-transition choreography
features.requirement: Preserve link event states, pauses, effects, forced motion and map handoff.

features.title: Dream timeouts and ending/reset encounters
features.requirement: Use original durations/tick conversion and distinguish normal, special, flashback and reset endings.

features.title: Dream mood accumulation, wrap and color classification
features.requirement: Accumulate chunk/encounter moods, average/wrap them and derive chart color.

features.title: Dream-chart history display
features.requirement: Display original graph coordinates, current-day emphasis and recent history across year wrap.

features.title: Mood-dependent initial stage and spawn
features.requirement: Choose starting map/chunk from prior mood or original random fallback with spawn/time adjustments.

features.title: Navigation and encounter unlock score
features.requirement: Preserve navigation flags, random-link penalty, encounter clamp and score-gated menu state.

features.title: Flashback recording, recall and loss
features.requirement: Record/replace recall slots, replay map/pose/day and clear memories on Gray Man triggers.

features.title: Special-day films and still screens
features.requirement: Use original special-day schedule/random variant and video or still-screen routing.

features.title: Chart-triggered bonus video reel
features.requirement: Recognize the four-cell history pattern once, highlight it and play the concatenated special reel.

features.title: Day-dependent stage texture variants
features.requirement: Select/load original stage textures as days progress with correct palette/uploads.

features.title: Procedural dream structures and palette seeding
features.requirement: Preserve day/location modes, structure placement, colors, updates and cleanup.

features.title: Distance-driven generated ambient encounters/effects
features.requirement: Activate ambient entries near players, run effect/sound commands, reuse two slots and stop out-of-range entries.

features.title: NPC perception, triggers and behavior lifecycle
features.requirement: Use original proximity/facing/height/random/time tests to start/stop interactions/scripts and emit events.

features.title: Original scripted NPC and moving-object behavior catalog
features.requirement: Preserve 107 distinct callbacks selected by 130 records, including timed poses, movements, random states and interaction consequences.

features.title: Encounter effects on mood, score, links and cinematics
features.requirement: Apply encounter notifications to mood/score, forced destinations, recall capture and cinematic/ending descriptors.

features.title: Actor model assembly and animation scripts
features.requirement: Build multipart actors, select sequences and apply original keyframe commands/timers.

features.title: Randomized stage music and soundtrack bank
features.requirement: Preserve bank/track selection, volume/crescendo and pause/resume behavior.

features.title: Encounter sound effects and command scheduler
features.requirement: Load instruments/map programs, play/stop/mute notes and synchronize three command slots with callbacks.

features.title: Streaming video playback
features.requirement: Read STR/XA streams, decode MDEC frames, synchronize playback and honor length/skip/cleanup.

features.title: Original 3D rendering and model geometry
features.requirement: Preserve transforms, primitive sorting/clipping, texturing, lighting and PS1 display output.

features.title: Color overlays, flashes, borders and shake
features.requirement: Run original attachment/lifetime, channel color steps, border presets and shake option.

features.title: Menu transitions, selection and sprites
features.requirement: Render original panels, highlights, timers, selection and child attach/detach transitions.

features.title: Text, glyphs, labels and decimal formatting
features.requirement: Preserve glyphs, string color/spacing, day-number formatting and updates.

features.title: Memory-card save and load of dream state
features.requirement: Store/restore the original 0x700-byte state with card path, label/icon and event outcomes.

features.title: Memory-card file management and error flow
features.requirement: Preserve selection, formatting/deletion, capacity, failure/cancel and card event handling.

features.title: Save comment/name entry
features.requirement: Edit the save label/comment with original glyphs, cursor, bounds and confirm/cancel behavior.

features.title: Disc reads and resource decoding
features.requirement: Preserve lookup/queues, asynchronous states, aligned buffers and TIM/resource lifetimes.

scope: Three original scalar behaviors plus development infrastructure; complete gameplay and presentation require independent comparisons.

asset_pipeline_20261013.scope: Original asset decoding and an offscreen Bevy asset-inspection scene; no whole gameplay or visual parity acceptance.

animation_import_20261013.scope: Bounded original animation-library decoding and independent static corpus counts. Runtime animation, NPC scripts and whole-game parity remain open.
